name: Truebill Rocket Money
description: Rocket Money, formerly Truebill, is a personal-finance app for tracking spending, subscriptions, bills, budgets, net worth, credit, and savings. Customers use it to understand recurring charges, manage household cash flow, and request supported subscription-cancellation or bill-negotiation services.
agentUseSummary: Truebill Rocket Money does not publish a supported third-party customer-account API, so Relay does not capture login credentials, automate private clients, or expose agent actions.
